paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Графиката илюстрира връзката между стойностите по оста Y и стойностите по оста X. Оста X е обозначена като "Rank", използва линейна скала, а диапазонът ѝ е от 4 до 256. Етикетите по оста X са 4, 16, 64 и 256. Оста Y е не е обозначена, използва линейна скала и диапазонът ѝ е от 0.3 до 0.9. На графиката е изобразена линия в черен цвят. Линията е плътна и преминава през точки, обозначени със зелени кръгове, всеки от които има вертикална грешка. В началото, при Rank = 4, стойността по оста Y е приблизително 0.55. Линията намалява до стойност около 0.45 при Rank = 16. След това има леко покачване до стойност около 0.5 при Rank = 64. Накрая, при Rank = 256, линията достига стойност приблизително 0.65. Вертикалните грешки при всяка точка варират между 0.05 и 0.1.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled "Rank" on the x-axis and a variable labeled "Error (RTE)" on the y-axis. The x-axis is a linear scale ranging from 4 to 256, with tick labels at 4, 16, 64, and 256, and no units are specified. The y-axis is a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.9, with tick labels at 0.3, 0.6, and 0.9, and no units are specified. A single black solid line with green circular markers is plotted, representing data points at the x-axis values. Starting at x=4, the line begins at a y-value of approximately 0.53, decreases to a y-value of approximately 0.45 at x=16, increases to a y-value of approximately 0.5 at x=64, and then increases again to a y-value of approximately 0.68 at x=256. Error bars, represented by vertical lines, are present at each data point, showing variance around the line.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die empirischen Generalisierungsfehler in Bezug auf die QLoRA-Gewichte dar. Die x-Achse ist als „Rang“ beschriftet und verwendet eine lineare Skala, die von 4 bis 256 reicht, in Schritten von 4, 16, 64 und 256. Die y-Achse ist nicht beschriftet, jedoch mit einer linearen Skala von 0,3 bis 0,9 in Schritten von 0,3. Das Diagramm enthält eine einzelne schwarze Linie, die durch grüne Kreise mit Fehlerbalken markiert ist. Die Linie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0,53 bei x = 4, fällt auf einen Wert von etwa 0,43 bei x = 16, steigt dann auf etwa 0,46 bei x = 64 und steigt schließlich auf etwa 0,64 bei x = 256.
